newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to reduce 6-yr JGB issue volume to 400 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: MOF to reduce 6-yr JGB issue volume to 400 bln yen.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday that it would reduce its bimonthly issue volume of six-year Japanese government bonds (JGB) to 400 billion yen from 500 billion yen.

The decision takes effect from Tuesday's auction of 6-year JGBs and a Finance Ministry official told Reuters the ministry plans to keep the issue volume at 400 billion yen, barring an extraordinary change in circumstances.
The official added that the MOF also plans to reduce the bimonthly issue volume of four-year JGBs to 400 billion yen from the current 500 billion yen.
